name: Sunbeam World School
format: Live lessons, and every lesson is also recorded; teacher-student ratio stated as 2:20; batch size not stated
timings: Monday to Saturday (bagless Saturdays), about 3.5 hours a day; three daily batches; morning batch 10:00 AM-1:30 PM IST
timings_note: Afternoon and evening batch hours are not listed and are confirmed by the counsellor. Grade 5 takes one batch a day.

curriculum.summary: The CBSE-aligned track is NCERT-based for Grades 1-12. Cambridge, Australian, American, NIOS and BOSSE tracks are also offered. Hindi and foreign languages are electives.

fees_note: CBSE-aligned Classes 1-2: Rs 54,898 a year; Classes 3-5: Rs 67,098 a year. Paid in three instalments, plus a Rs 999 board registration fee in year one. Fees are non-refundable.
how_to_check: Fee structure page (sunbeamworldschool.com/fee-structure/) and the Class 5 page for timings.
gaps: syllabus PDF (only content books and digital resources PDFs exist)
